svg.title: ScienceEvolve · Edit a turbulence modeling workflow.
svg.desc: During a turbulence-modeling study, the user switches Harnesses, adds an independent model Verifier, and adds a collaboration group to check theory and data in parallel. The original user avatars and three-version composition remain. Agent cards label their Harness: Codex, DSH or pi, preserving the depicted configuration across recovery and intentional version changes.
svg.text: Check theory and data in parallel.
